invariants.rationale: The method expects to operate on a WorkloadProfile; null would likely cause a NullPointerException.
The HoodieEngineContext is required for internal processing, and many subsequent operations would assume it is non-null.
The set of partition paths is obtained via profile.getPartitionPaths(), which is expected to be non-null for correct processing.
Processing is loop-based over partition paths, so it is likely expected that the set is non-empty at method entry.

The implementation calls hasOutputWorkLoadStats() prior to accessing getOutputPartitionPathStatMap(); this may indicate an equivalence or expectation that hasOutputWorkLoadStats() implies non-null stats map.
